about_the_game:
Story

Will the world destroy the God of Demons — or the God of Heaven?

Since ancient times, legends have spoken of this prophecy,

a tale that has ignited endless conflict in the hearts of humankind.

Now, as darkness threatens to engulf the world,

a single ray of light descends from the heavens.

This is a story from the age when the Demon Lord still walked the earth.

A village was consumed by the Demon Lord’s army —

its people slaughtered, their homes swallowed by fire.

Rain fell upon the blackened ruins,

as though the heavens themselves were weeping in silence.

Within the church, a young soul prayed endlessly to the God above.

Yet no answer came — only silence.

When the flames finally faded,

the girl who had never ceased to pray was bathed in light.

“If God will not save us,” she declared,

“then I shall become the one who will.”

Guided by the light, she received the Sword of Seven,

a blade said to shine with divine radiance — and then, the light vanished.

Five years passed.

The Demon Lord was defeated,

and for a fleeting moment, peace returned to the world.

Game Description
An epic, story-driven fantasy JRPG: “Seven Heroes of Lament”.
Featuring a fully-voiced main story with over 120 professional voice actors, offering a rich narrative and deeply strategic battles.

Awards & Achievements

  • Grand Prize, Freegame Mugen Awards

  • Fighting Spirit Award, PLiCY Game Contest

  • Over 100,000 total plays (PLiCY version)

🎮 Gameplay Features

  • A fusion of Turn-Based Combat, CTB (Casting Time Battle), and ATB (Active Time Battle)

  • Strategic customization of skills, equipment, and characters, exploiting weaknesses and resistances

  • Clear UI with both color and icon indicators for status effects and attributes

  • Supports keyboard, mouse, and controller (with fully customizable button mapping)

  • Save anytime, with adjustable BGM and SE volume settings

Your choices will shape the story in this moving fantasy epic.
